create-pdf-custom-title-page.title: Create PDF Title Page with Custom Font and Color
create-pdf-custom-title-page.description: Demonstrates creating a new PDF, adding a title page with a light‑gray background, and placing a centered title using a custom font, size, and color.

insert-image-into-pdf-absolute-coordinat.title: Insert High‑Resolution Image into PDF with Absolute Positioning
insert-image-into-pdf-absolute-coordinat.description: Demonstrates loading a high‑resolution image, converting its pixel size to PDF points, and placing it on a PDF page at specific X/Y coordinates using Aspose.Pdf.

create-searchable-pdf-from-scanned-image.title: Create Searchable PDF by Adding Invisible OCR Text
create-searchable-pdf-from-scanned-image.description: Demonstrates loading a scanned PDF, extracting OCR text (placeholder), and overlaying it as invisible text using Aspose.Pdf to produce a searchable PDF.

add-indented-paragraph-with-line-spacing.title: Add Indentation and Line Spacing to PDF Text
add-indented-paragraph-with-line-spacing.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a TextFragment, applies a left margin for paragraph indentation and sets line spacing, then adds it to the first page and saves the document.

add-multi-level-toc-to-pdf.title: Add Table of Contents to PDF with Aspose.Pdf
add-multi-level-toc-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to detect headings in an existing PDF, insert a new page, and create a clickable table of contents that links to each heading's page using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-page-from-pdf.title: Remove a Page from PDF and Renumber Remaining Pages
remove-page-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, deleting a specific page, and saving the document. Remaining pages are automatically renumbered.

insert-blank-cover-page-into-pdf.title: Insert Blank Cover Page into PDF
insert-blank-cover-page-into-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, insert a new blank page at the beginning as a cover sheet, and save the updated document.

replace-word-in-pdf.title: Replace Text in PDF While Preserving Formatting
replace-word-in-pdf.description: Shows how to search for a specific word in a PDF and replace it with another word using Aspose.Pdf, keeping the original font, size, and color.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page's image resources, and save each image as a PNG file while preserving its original resolution.

add-digital-signature-to-pdf.title: Add Digital Signature to PDF with Self‑Signed Certificate
add-digital-signature-to-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a self‑signed certificate, create a signature field on a PDF page, and apply a digital signature using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-a1a-compliance-report.title: Validate PDF for PDF/A‑1A Compliance and Generate Report
validate-pdf-a1a-compliance-report.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf to validate a PDF file against PDF/A‑1A conformance and create a detailed validation report with a summary.

validate-pdf-a1b-compliance.title: Validate PDF for PDF/A-1B Compliance
validate-pdf-a1b-compliance.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf to validate a PDF file against PDF/A‑1B standards and write any non‑conformant elements to a log file.

remove-metadata-javascript-embedded-file.title: Clean PDF Metadata, JavaScript, and Embedded Files
remove-metadata-javascript-embedded-file.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, remove standard document information, clear XMP metadata, delete document‑level JavaScript, and strip embedded file attachments before saving the cleaned file.

set-pdf-expiration-date.title: Set PDF Expiration with JavaScript
set-pdf-expiration-date.description: Shows how to embed JavaScript in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf to make the document automatically expire on a specified date when opened.

flatten-pdf-form-fields.title: Flatten PDF Form Fields to Static Content
flatten-pdf-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to convert all interactive form fields in a PDF into static content using Aspose.Pdf, and then save the flattened document.

check-pdf-incremental-updates.title: Detect Incremental Updates in PDF
check-pdf-incremental-updates.description: Shows how to determine whether a PDF has been modified after its creation by inspecting incremental update information via Aspose.Pdf and reflection.

add-watermark-layer-merge-layers.title: Add Watermark Artifact Layer to PDF Pages
add-watermark-layer-merge-layers.description: Demonstrates how to create a watermark artifact as an optional‑content layer, apply it to each page of an existing PDF, and save the merged result using Aspose.Pdf.

add-accessibility-tags-to-pdf.title: Add Accessibility Tags to PDF (Headings, Paragraphs, Table)
add-accessibility-tags-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, enable tagged content, and add accessibility tags such as headings, paragraphs, and a table with proper structure and alternative text using Aspose.Pdf.

attach-portfolio-pdf-set-description-met.title: Attach PDF Portfolio and Set Description Metadata
attach-portfolio-pdf-set-description-met.description: This example demonstrates how to attach another PDF as a portfolio file to an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf, and how to set a custom description metadata entry.

update-pdf-author-title-metadata.title: Read and Update PDF Metadata (Author and Title)
update-pdf-author-title-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read its existing author and title metadata, modify these fields, and save the updated document.

apply-password-protection-to-pdf.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords and Set Permissions
apply-password-protection-to-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption with separate user and owner passwords, defines allowed permissions, and saves the protected document.

print-pdf-using-default-handler.title: Print PDF Document from .NET Using Shell Verb
print-pdf-using-default-handler.description: Shows how to verify a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and then send it to the default printer using the operating system's "print" verb via Process.Start.

interrupt-resume-large-pdf-save.title: Incremental Save of Large PDF in Batches
interrupt-resume-large-pdf-save.description: Demonstrates how to save a large PDF incrementally by processing pages in batches, releasing resources after each batch, and resuming the save operation.

generate-crash-report-pdf.title: Generate Crash Report PDF with Exception Details
generate-crash-report-pdf.description: Creates a PDF file that contains the type, message, and stack trace of a caught exception using Aspose.Pdf. Demonstrates basic document creation, text placement, and saving.

embed-zugferd-xml-into-pdf.title: Embed ZUGFeRD XML into PDF and Verify Extraction
embed-zugferd-xml-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a ZUGFeRD invoice XML file into a PDF, convert the document to PDF/A‑3B for compliance, and then extract the embedded XML to confirm it was stored correctly.

add-javascript-open-action-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Open Action to PDF
add-javascript-open-action-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript action that runs when a PDF is opened, displaying an alert dialog. The example loads an existing PDF, sets the OpenAction, and saves the result.

combine-multiple-html-to-pdf.title: Create PDF from Multiple HTML Strings with Custom Page Size
combine-multiple-html-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to render several HTML strings into individual PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf, apply a fixed A4 page size, and merge them into a single PDF document.

add-styled-table-alternating-row-colors.title: Add Styled Table with Borders and Alternating Row Colors to PDF
add-styled-table-alternating-row-colors.description: Shows how to create a three‑column table, apply outer and cell borders, style the header, add alternating background colors for data rows, and insert the table into a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Hyperlink Annotation to PDF
add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a clickable hyperlink annotation that opens an external website in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-image-in-pdf-page.title: Replace Image on PDF Page
replace-image-in-pdf-page.description: Shows how to replace an existing raster image on a specific PDF page with a new image while preserving its layout (position, size, rotation) using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-numbers-to-pdf-footer.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Footer
add-page-numbers-to-pdf-footer.description: Shows how to insert sequential page numbers at the bottom center of each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp.

create-pdf-multiple-sections-different-p.title: Create PDF with Multiple Page Sizes and Orientations
create-pdf-multiple-sections-different-p.description: Shows how to add pages of different sizes and orientations (portrait and landscape) to a single PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.title: Merge PDFs and Preserve Bookmarks
merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.description: Shows how to combine two PDF files into a single document while keeping the original bookmark (outline) hierarchy using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-text-from-pdf-pages.title: Extract Text from Specific PDF Pages
extract-text-from-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract text from a defined page range using TextAbsorber, and write the result to a plain text file.

add-company-logo-header-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Company Logo Header to PDF Pages
add-company-logo-header-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp for a logo, position it as a header on every page, and save the modified document.

set-pdf-document-metadata.title: Set PDF Document Properties (Creation Date, Modification Date, Keywords)
set-pdf-document-metadata.description: Shows how to create a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, add a page, and set the document's creation date, modification date, and custom keywords before saving.

create-pdf-with-embedded-truetype-font.title: Create PDF with Embedded TrueType Font
create-pdf-with-embedded-truetype-font.description: Demonstrates how to register a TrueType font, set it to be embedded, and generate a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so the text renders consistently on any device.

apply-semi-transparent-image-watermark.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Watermark to PDF Pages
apply-semi-transparent-image-watermark.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a semi‑transparent TextStamp, and applying it as a watermark to every page before saving the document.

create-clickable-table-of-contents.title: Create Clickable Table of Contents in PDF
create-clickable-table-of-contents.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with a Table of Contents where each entry is a clickable link that jumps to the corresponding section heading using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf.title: Remove All Annotations from a PDF
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, clear all annotations, and save a clean, annotation‑free document.

add-signature-field-to-pdf.title: Add Signature Field with Styled Appearance to PDF
add-signature-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a signature form field, customize its background, border and placeholder text appearance, and save the updated document.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-restrict-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Restrict Printing/Copying
encrypt-pdf-aes256-restrict-permissions.description: Shows how to apply AES‑256 encryption to a PDF, set user and owner passwords, and disable printing and copying permissions using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-portfolio.title: Create PDF Portfolio with Embedded PDFs
create-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to build a PDF portfolio by embedding multiple PDF files into a single container using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-document-info-and-xmp-metadat.title: Add Custom XML Metadata to PDF
add-custom-document-info-and-xmp-metadat.description: Demonstrates how to embed custom XML metadata and simple key/value pairs into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's DocumentInfo dictionary, then save the updated file.

add-line-annotation-with-custom-color-th.title: Add Line Annotation with Custom Color and Thickness to PDF
add-line-annotation-with-custom-color-th.description: Shows how to locate specific text in a PDF using TextFragmentAbsorber and overlay it with a line annotation that has a custom red color and 2‑point thickness using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-pdf-page-with-html.title: Replace PDF Page with HTML‑Generated Page
replace-pdf-page-with-html.description: Shows how to replace a specific page in an existing PDF with a new page created from HTML using Aspose.Pdf's HTML‑to‑PDF conversion.

add-javascript-sum-calculation-to-pdf-fo.title: Add JavaScript Sum Calculation to PDF Form
add-javascript-sum-calculation-to-pdf-fo.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF with two input fields, a read‑only result field, and a button that runs JavaScript to calculate and display the sum of the inputs.

generate-dynamic-pdf-table.title: Create PDF with Dynamic Table and Accessibility Tags
generate-dynamic-pdf-table.description: Shows how to generate a PDF with a table whose rows are added dynamically from a collection and how to add accessibility tags to the table using Aspose.Pdf.

create-zugferd-compliant-pdf-invoice.title: Create ZUGFeRD‑Compliant PDF Invoice with Embedded XML
create-zugferd-compliant-pdf-invoice.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF invoice using Aspose.Pdf and embed ZUGFeRD XML data as an attached file to meet the ZUGFeRD standard.

create-pdf-clickable-index.title: Create PDF with Clickable Index
create-pdf-clickable-index.description: Shows how to generate a PDF that contains an index page where each entry links to its corresponding section using link annotations and explicit XYZ destinations.

add-background-template-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Background Image to All PDF Pages
add-background-template-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to apply a background image to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by creating an ImageStamp sized to each page and adding it as a background stamp.

add-signature-image-stamp-to-last-page.title: Add Signature Appearance with Image on Last PDF Page
add-signature-image-stamp-to-last-page.description: Demonstrates how to create a signature field on the last page of a PDF and apply a custom image as its visual appearance using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.title: Extract Embedded Files from PDF Portfolio
extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF portfolio with Aspose.Pdf, enumerate its embedded files, and save each file to a specified directory while handling name collisions.

create-readonly-text-field-with-default-.title: Create Read‑Only Text Field in PDF
create-readonly-text-field-with-default-.description: Shows how to add a text box form field with a default value and set it to read‑only, including basic appearance settings, using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-clickable-email-link.title: Create PDF with Clickable Email Link
create-pdf-with-clickable-email-link.description: Shows how to generate a PDF that contains a clickable mailto: link using Aspose.Pdf annotations.

add-captions-below-images-in-pdf.title: Add Captions Below Each Image in a PDF
add-captions-below-images-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through PDF pages, locate images, and add a styled caption paragraph beneath each image using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-toc-with-dot-leaders.title: Create PDF Table of Contents with Dot Leaders
create-pdf-toc-with-dot-leaders.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF containing a table of contents where each entry includes custom dot leaders between the title and page number using Aspose.Pdf.

add-popup-note-annotation.title: Add Pop‑up Note Annotation to PDF
add-popup-note-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a TextAnnotation (pop‑up note) with a title and contents, place it on a page, and save the updated document.

create-pdf-header-with-current-date.title: Create PDF Header with Current Date Using JavaScript
create-pdf-header-with-current-date.description: Shows how to add a read‑only text box in the PDF header and fill it with the current date via a JavaScript open action using Aspose.Pdf.

digitally-sign-pdf-with-timestamp.title: Digitally Sign PDF with Timestamp from TSA
digitally-sign-pdf-with-timestamp.description: Shows how to add a digital signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and include a trusted timestamp from a Time‑Stamp Authority.

create-5x7-inch-postcard-pdf.title: Create 5x7 Inch Postcard PDF
create-5x7-inch-postcard-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with a custom 5x7‑inch page size and add a simple text fragment using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-color-to-pdf-page.title: Add Semi-Transparent Background Color to PDF Page
add-background-color-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to add a semi‑transparent light‑gray rectangle as a background to the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf drawing objects.

insert-pdf-page-into-another.title: Insert a Page from One PDF into Another
insert-pdf-page-into-another.description: Demonstrates extracting a specific page from a source PDF and inserting it into a target PDF at a given 1‑based position using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-dropdown-list.title: Create PDF Form with Dropdown List
create-pdf-with-dropdown-list.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF document containing a ComboBox (dropdown) form field, populate its options from an array, set a default selection, and save the file.

add-page-count-footer-to-pdf.title: Add Custom Footer with Page Numbers to PDF
add-page-count-footer-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a centered footer on each PDF page that displays "Page X of Y" using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-javascript-from-pdf.title: Remove JavaScript Actions from PDF
remove-javascript-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to strip all JavaScript from a PDF, including document‑level scripts, page actions, and annotation actions, using Aspose.Pdf and reflection.

create-pdf-with-merged-header-table.title: Create PDF Table with Merged Header Cells
create-pdf-with-merged-header-table.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a table where the first header row has a cell that spans all columns, followed by regular column headers and data rows.

add-link-annotation-open-pdf-attachment.title: Add Clickable Attachment Annotation to PDF
add-link-annotation-open-pdf-attachment.description: Demonstrates embedding a PDF file into another PDF and creating a file‑attachment annotation that opens the embedded document when clicked.

create-rotated-landscape-pdf-page.title: Create Landscape PDF Page
create-rotated-landscape-pdf-page.description: Shows how to create a PDF, add a page, set its dimensions to landscape orientation, insert a text fragment, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-checked-checkbox-form-field.title: Add Checkbox Form Field to PDF
add-checked-checkbox-form-field.description: Shows how to insert a checkbox form field into an existing PDF document and set its default state to checked using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-outline-hierarchy.title: Extract and Print PDF Outline Hierarchy
extract-pdf-outline-hierarchy.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, accessing its outline (bookmarks) collection, and recursively printing the hierarchy as a tree structure.

create-pdf-table-with-rich-text.title: Create PDF Table with Rich Text Formatting
create-pdf-table-with-rich-text.description: Shows how to generate a PDF document containing a table where each cell includes text with different styles such as bold, italic, color, and underline using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Diagonal Text Stamp to PDF Pages
add-diagonal-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and add a rotated text stamp (e.g., CONFIDENTIAL) across each page using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-automatic-page-numbers-into-pdf.title: Add Automatic Page Numbers to PDF
insert-automatic-page-numbers-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a page number stamp that updates automatically when pages are added or removed in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-background-template.title: Create PDF with Template Background Page
create-pdf-with-background-template.description: Shows how to load a PDF page as a background template and clone it to generate multiple pages in a new PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.title: Extract Text from PDF to UTF-8 File
extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract all plain text using TextAbsorber, and write the result to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

add-javascript-sum-numeric-pdf-form-fiel.title: Add JavaScript to Sum Numeric PDF Form Fields
add-javascript-sum-numeric-pdf-form-fiel.description: Shows how to embed a custom JavaScript function in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf to calculate and display the total of numeric form fields on document open or when fields lose focus.

extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Extract XMP Metadata from PDF to XML
extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read its embedded XMP metadata, and write the metadata to an XML file.

create-multi-page-table-pdf.title: Create Multi‑Page Table in PDF with Aspose.Pdf
create-multi-page-table-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a table that automatically flows across multiple pages, with a repeating header row, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-line-separator-annotation-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Line Separator Annotation to PDF
add-line-separator-annotation-to-pdf-pag.description: Shows how to insert a horizontal line annotation as a section separator on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-page-rotation-90-degrees.title: Set PDF Page Rotation to 90 Degrees
set-pdf-page-rotation-90-degrees.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate each page 90° for portrait display on landscape devices, and save the modified document.

create-pdf-with-date-picker.title: Create PDF with Date Picker TextBox Field
create-pdf-with-date-picker.description: Shows how to generate a PDF document and add a TextBoxField that functions as a date picker, including setting a default date value.

extract-hyperlinks-from-pdf.title: Extract Hyperlinks from PDF and Save to Text File
extract-hyperlinks-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages and link annotations, collects URI actions, and writes the extracted hyperlinks to a plain‑text file.

load-pdf-into-document.title: Load PDF and Read Document Metadata
load-pdf-into-document.description: Demonstrates checking for a PDF file, loading it into an Aspose.Pdf Document, and retrieving basic metadata such as page count, title, and author.

sanitize-pdf-remove-embedded-scripts.title: Sanitize PDF by Removing Embedded JavaScript
sanitize-pdf-remove-embedded-scripts.description: The example loads a PDF, optionally deletes attached files, configures HiddenDataSanitizationOptions to remove JavaScript actions, sanitizes the document, and saves the cleaned PDF.

sanitize-pdf-remove-metadata-private-inf.title: Remove Search Index and Private Info from PDF
sanitize-pdf-remove-metadata-private-inf.description: Demonstrates how to enable the RemoveSearchIndexAndPrivateInfo flag to clear PDF metadata using Aspose.Pdf's hidden‑data sanitization feature and save the sanitized document.

convert-pdf-pages-to-rasterized-images-h.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Rasterized Pages
convert-pdf-pages-to-rasterized-images-h.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configure HtmlSaveOptions to rasterize each page as external PNG images (referenced via SVG), and save the output as a single HTML file.

compress-pdf-images-and-export-jpeg-qual.title: Convert PDF Pages to JPEG Images with Quality 80
compress-pdf-images-and-export-jpeg-qual.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, iterating through its pages, and saving each page as a JPEG image using Aspose.Pdf with a compression quality of 80.

convert-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-no-compression.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG Images without Compression
convert-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-no-compression.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and save each page as a lossless PNG image, ensuring no compression is applied during conversion.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images.title: Sanitize PDF and Convert Pages to PNG Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images.description: Shows how to remove hidden data from a PDF using HiddenDataSanitizer and then render each page as a separate PNG image file.

remove-annotations-and-attachments.title: Remove Annotations and Attachments from PDF
remove-annotations-and-attachments.description: Shows how to delete all page annotations (comments, markup) and embedded file attachments from a PDF and save the cleaned document using Aspose.Pdf.

sanitize-pdfs-remove-metadata.title: Sanitize PDFs by Removing Metadata and Annotations
sanitize-pdfs-remove-metadata.description: Demonstrates loading PDF files, clearing their metadata and annotations, and saving the sanitized copies to a target directory.

generate-pdf-crash-report.title: Generate Crash Report for PDF Loading Errors
generate-pdf-crash-report.description: Demonstrates catching a PdfException, configuring CrashReportOptions, and generating a crash report file with Aspose.Pdf.

customize-crash-report-filename-message.title: Encrypt, Decrypt and Convert PDF to HTML
customize-crash-report-filename-message.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF with user and owner passwords, decrypt it, extract its text, and save the document as an HTML file using Aspose.Pdf.

generate-crash-report-with-custom-output.title: Generate Crash Report to Specified Directory with Aspose.Pdf
generate-crash-report-with-custom-output.description: Shows how to configure CrashReportOptions to output a crash report to a custom folder and verify that the report file is created after an exception.

pdf-processing-with-crash-report.title: Process PDF with Text Extraction and Detailed Error Logging
pdf-processing-with-crash-report.description: Shows how to load a PDF, extract its text, save the document, and capture any exceptions with a comprehensive crash‑report written to a log file.

add-level-1-heading-to-pdf.title: Add Level 1 Heading to PDF
add-level-1-heading-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF document, set its language and title, and add a Level 1 heading using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API, then save the file.

add-hierarchical-numbered-headings.title: Apply Decimal Numbering to PDF Headings
add-hierarchical-numbered-headings.description: Shows how to add hierarchical headings with Arabic decimal numbering to a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

structured-toc-with-headings.title: Create Table of Contents with Various Numbering Styles
structured-toc-with-headings.description: Demonstrates how to add multiple Heading objects with different NumberingStyle values to build a structured table of contents in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-new-bookmark-to-pdf-outline.title: Insert New Bookmark into PDF Outline
add-new-bookmark-to-pdf-outline.description: Shows how to add a top‑level outline (bookmark) to an existing PDF, place it at a specific index in the outline hierarchy, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-dynamic-heading-to-pdf.title: Add Dynamic Heading to PDF Using Tagged Content
add-dynamic-heading-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a level‑1 heading with dynamic text (user name and date) via the tagged content API, and save the updated document.

create-pdf-numbered-headings-sanitize.title: Create and Sanitize PDF Headings with Aspose.Pdf
create-pdf-numbered-headings-sanitize.description: Demonstrates how to generate a tagged PDF containing hierarchical headings and then produce a sanitized version that retains only the heading structure and numbering.

batch-sanitize-pdfs.title: Batch Sanitize PDFs by Removing Metadata, Scripts, Attachments, and Annotations
batch-sanitize-pdfs.description: Processes all PDF files in a folder, clears document metadata, removes JavaScript actions, embedded files, and page annotations, then saves cleaned copies to an output directory.

sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data.title: Sanitize PDF by Removing Hidden Data
sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, strip hidden information such as annotations, metadata, and embedded files, and save the cleaned document to a new file.

check-hidden-annotations-in-pdf.title: Check for Hidden Annotations After PDF Sanitization
check-hidden-annotations-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, sanitizes it using Aspose.Pdf's hidden‑data sanitizer (or falls back to manual removal), and then verifies whether any annotations with the Hidden flag remain.

sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data-keep-met.title: Sanitize PDF Hidden Data While Keeping Metadata
sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data-keep-met.description: Demonstrates how to configure Aspose.Pdf's HiddenDataSanitizer to remove all hidden content from a PDF while preserving the document metadata. The example also shows how to delete embedded files before sanitization.

convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-tif.title: Convert PDF Pages to High-Resolution TIFF Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-tif.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a TiffDevice at a specified DPI, and save each page as an individual TIFF file.

roman-numeral-headings-pdf.title: Create PDF with Roman Numeral Headings and Verify Sequence
roman-numeral-headings-pdf.description: Generates a PDF where each section heading is prefixed with a Roman numeral, then reads the document back to ensure the numerals appear in the correct sequential order.

sanitize-pdf-add-heading.title: Create Tagged, Navigable PDF with Clean Content
sanitize-pdf-add-heading.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, copying its pages to a new document, and using Aspose.Pdf tagging APIs to add language, title, headings and paragraphs, producing an accessible, navigable PDF.

log-pdf-sanitization-start-end-times.title: Sanitize PDF by Removing Metadata and Annotations with Audit Logging
log-pdf-sanitization-start-end-times.description: Demonstrates how to clean a PDF by clearing its metadata and annotations, then saving the sanitized file while recording start and end timestamps for each step in an audit log.

add-page-with-text-to-pdf.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Progress Indicator
add-page-with-text-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, convert it to HTML using Aspose.Pdf, and manually update a console progress bar to reflect start and completion.

magazine-pdf-creator.title: Create Magazine-Style PDF with Two-Column Layout and Advertisement
magazine-pdf-creator.description: Shows how to generate a PDF with a two‑column article layout using a table and optionally add a full‑page advertisement image.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v2.title: Remove All Annotations from PDF using HiddenDataSanitizer
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to configure HiddenDataSanitizerOptions to strip every annotation from a PDF and save the sanitized document.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images__v2.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, and save each page as an individual PNG image file.

generate-pdf-crash-report__v2.title: Extract Text from PDF with Custom Crash Report
generate-pdf-crash-report__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, extracting all its text using Aspose.Pdf, and saving the document while generating a detailed custom crash report on errors.

customize-toc-formatting.title: Add Bookmark to PDF Document
customize-toc-formatting.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a top‑level bookmark (outline) that links to the first page, and save the modified file.

create-pdf-radio-button-group.title: Create PDF Quiz Form with Radio Buttons
create-pdf-radio-button-group.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF containing a multiple‑choice quiz using Aspose.Pdf, adding radio‑button groups for each question and setting a default selection.
